title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Five-scene monumental Spaces engine
preserve: Map 5 strict maximum two visible signs

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v30 makes Map 5 substantially more brutalist and infinite-feeling: bridge half-width .95 (full width 1.9), lateral limit .68, column gap 1.20, column radius 3.20, shafts from Y=-48 to Y=48/58. The bright orange background is replaced by a near-black industrial void, weak distant horizon glow, subdued destination temple, and a cheap world-space layer of distant megatower silhouettes that shifts naturally with forward movement.

open_feedback: Review whether the 1.9-unit bridge now feels like a thin suspended walkway rather than a floor.
Review whether radius-3.2 towers at a 1.20 abyss gap feel more massive and slightly farther from the bridge.
Review whether the dark void + weak horizon glow improves monumental scale without flattening the scene.
Review whether distant megatower silhouettes feel like infinite architecture rather than decorative shapes.
Preserve low camera, bridge-last occlusion, black deep bases, hidden signs and max-two-sign rule.
